answer: Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each new agent to stake a bonded deposit and pass a proof-of-personhood challenge, such as solving a unique lotus-pattern puzzle tied to a verified identity. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must pay the full deposit per identity plus the compute cost of solving each puzzle, making the marginal cost per sybil rise with the delta between real and fabricated identities.
